terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to AgroMarket. By accessing and using our platform, you agree to comply with these terms and conditions.

sections.title: 1. Use of the platform
sections.text: AgroMarket enables the purchase and sale of agricultural products between producers and buyers.

sections.title: 2. User accounts
sections.text: Some services require an account and truthful, up-to-date information.

sections.title: 3. Products and prices
sections.text: Producers are responsible for product information, prices and availability. Producer prices are stored in Colombian pesos (COP).

sections.title: 4. Payments
sections.text: Payments are processed through the methods enabled by the platform. Display currency does not change the original financial value stored in COP.

sections.title: 5. Shipping and delivery
sections.text: Delivery times and costs may vary according to current settings and locations.

terms.acceptance: By continuing to use AgroMarket, you accept these terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At AgroMarket, we respect your privacy and protect your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information.

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
sections.text: Name, email, phone, address and information related to purchases and platform use.

sections.title: 2. Use of information
sections.text: We use your data to process orders, improve services, protect accounts and communicate when necessary.

sections.title: 3. Data protection
sections.text: We implement security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access.

sections.title: 4. Your rights
sections.text: You can request access, updates or deletion of your data through the options available on the platform.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: We use cookies to improve your AgroMarket experience. This policy explains what cookies are and how we use them.

sections.title: 1. What are cookies?
sections.text: Small files stored on your device to remember preferences and improve your experience.

sections.title: 2. Cookie types we use
paragraphs: Essential: required for the site to work.
Analytics: help us understand platform usage.
Preferences: remember settings such as language and currency.

sections.title: 3. Managing cookies
sections.text: You can accept, configure or manage cookies through the platform and browser options.

cookies.preferencesText: Essential cookies remain active. You can save your preferences for other categories.

comoFunciona.title: How does AgroMarket work?
comoFunciona.subtitle: Buying the freshest products from the Colombian countryside is now a simple, direct reality without harmful intermediaries.

step1.title: Explore and Discover
step1.text: Browse our catalog of fruits, vegetables, tubers and delights grown directly in Colombian Urabá.

step2.title: Choose Your Harvest
step2.text: Select the desired quantities. You will see exactly which farm harvested each product and at what fair price they suggest.

step3.title: Buy with Confidence
step3.text: Make your 100% secure payment through multiple options quickly and easily.

step4.title: Receive at Home
step4.text: Our peasant logistics network collects the fresh product of the day and delivers it directly to your door.

comoFunciona.whyTitle: We support local and return value to the countryside
comoFunciona.whyText1: Traditionally, agricultural intermediaries retain up to 70% of a product's value, leaving our farmers with losses.
comoFunciona.whyText2: At AgroMarket, 100% of the sale goes directly to local producer associations. By buying here, you are allowing families in Urabá to continue cultivating their lands with decent living conditions, education and regional development.

faq1.q: How do I make a purchase on the platform?
faq1.a: It's very simple: browse the store, select your favorite fruits or tubers, tell us how many kilos you need, enter your shipping information, and make the secure online payment.

faq2.a: We accept PSE transfers, credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), and Colombian mobile digital wallet applications.

faq3.q: How long does it take for my order to arrive?
faq3.a: Orders are coordinated directly to be harvested in the morning. We take between 24 and 48 hours to dispatch and deliver to your door to maintain guaranteed freshness.

faq4.q: How can I join if I am a producer in Urabá?
faq4.a: You can contact the Asafrut association through our WhatsApp technical support or fill out the form in the producers tab. We will help you with the physical verification of your farm.

faq5.a: If a batch of fruits or vegetables does not arrive in the optimal freshness agreed upon, you can send us a photo to the support chat within the first 12 hours of receipt and we will replace it at no additional cost.
